sourceAccess.note: 抓取成功。关键原句:"Nurse bees feed the worker larvae worker jelly, which is secreted from glands that produce royal jelly."(哺育蜂 days 3–12 小节);"Queen attendants take care of the queen by feeding and grooming her."(days 7–11 小节);"Nurse bees feed it royal jelly for three days, followed by pollen and honey for about two more days until the cell is capped by worker bees."

抓取成功。关键原句:"Workers and queen larvae are both fed royal jelly ... during the first three days. After that, larval prospective workers are switched to a diet of mixed pollen and nectar (often called 'bee bread')";"After about a week, the larva is sealed in its cell by the nurse bees and begins its pupal stage.";"For the first 10 days of their lives, worker bees clean the hive and feed the larvae." 未提及幼虫体重增长。

抓取成功。关键原句:"Populations of O. cornifrons have been recorded in multiple locations, including Japan, Korea, China, and Russia.";"In 1977, O. cornifrons was introduced in the northeastern United States in an attempt to increase pollination productivity of fruit crops.";"Males emerge from their nests around April, just prior to the blooming of apple orchards.";"Females arise from their nests 2–3 days later.";"Eggs are placed on top of the pollen ball.";"The wintering period is when bees are enclosed in cocoons"

抓取成功。关键原句:"When the bees emerge from their cocoons, the males exit first."(雄蜂留在巢附近等待雌蜂);"When the females emerge, they mate with one or several males.";"Once a provision mass is complete, the bee backs into the hole and lays an egg on top of the mass.";"Within weeks of hatching, the larva has probably consumed all of its provisions and begins spinning a cocoon around itself.";"The adult matures either in the fall or winter, hibernating inside its insulatory cocoon.";"Osmia species are solitary; every female is fertile and makes her own nest, and no worker bees for these species exist."

抓取成功。关键原句:"O. cornifrons is native to eastern Asia and has been found in Japan and Korea as well as the southeast coast of Russia";"intentionally introduced to the eastern U.S. from Japan in the 1970s to increase crop pollination";"O. cornifrons have been recorded in flight in the U.S from March to June, with the majority of occurrences through April.";"commonly used commercially for the pollination of apple orchards"。未提及雄蜂先出天数、卵与花粉团。

issues.claim: 幼虫在约 6 天的幼虫期里体重增长极快
issues.problem: 低severity·未提及。两个来源均未给出幼虫体重增长的表述;"约 6 天"已用"约"限定,且与 Worker bee(3 天王浆 + 约 2 天花粉蜂蜜后封盖)及 Western honey bee("After about a week, the larva is sealed")大致相符。"体重增长极快"属通用科普性描述,不改变裁决。
issues.evidence: Worker bee:"Nurse bees feed it royal jelly for three days, followed by pollen and honey for about two more days until the cell is capped by worker bees.";Western honey bee:"After about a week, the larva is sealed in its cell by the nurse bees and begins its pupal stage."
issues.fix: 可保留;若想完全落地到来源,可改为"幼虫在约 6 天的幼虫期里被反复投喂,长得极快",或补一条给出幼虫增重倍数的来源。

issues.claim: 哺育蜂用腺体分泌的乳状食物喂养工蜂幼虫(常称"工蜂浆",与蜂王浆来自同一类腺体);约出房后第 7–11 天也会给蜂王喂食、梳理体表;出房后第 3–12 天;工蜂幼虫三天后改吃花粉和花蜜调成的蜂粮
issues.problem: 已核对,全部被支持(记录用)。
issues.evidence: Worker bee(Nurse bees, days 3–12 小节):"Nurse bees feed the worker larvae worker jelly, which is secreted from glands that produce royal jelly.";(Queen attendants, days 7–11 小节):"Queen attendants take care of the queen by feeding and grooming her.";Western honey bee:"Workers and queen larvae are both fed royal jelly ... during the first three days. After that, larval prospective workers are switched to a diet of mixed pollen and nectar (often called 'bee bread')"

issues.claim: 雌蜂晚几天出来(不同资料从两三天到约一周)
issues.problem: 低severity·部分未提及但已限定。Osmia cornifrons 词条明确给出 2–3 天;"约一周"在三个来源中均未出现,但已用"不同资料"限定,按已恰当限定处理。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons:"Females arise from their nests 2–3 days later.";Mason bee:"When the bees emerge from their cocoons, the males exit first."
issues.fix: 可保留;若希望全部落地,可改为"雌蜂晚 2–3 天出来",或在来源列表中补入给出"约一周"的资料。

issues.claim: 在原产地东亚(日本、朝鲜半岛、中国等)与引入地北美,出巢时间大致在 4 月
issues.problem: 低severity·来源关于 4 月出巢的句子未区分产地与引入地(Osmia cornifrons 词条是泛述,idtools 的 3–6 月飞行记录仅限美国);"大致"已限定,产地列表与引入北美均被支持。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons:"Males emerge from their nests around April, just prior to the blooming of apple orchards.";"Populations of O. cornifrons have been recorded in multiple locations, including Japan, Korea, China, and Russia.";"In 1977, O. cornifrons was introduced in the northeastern United States";Exotic Bee ID:"native to eastern Asia and has been found in Japan and Korea as well as the southeast coast of Russia"
issues.fix: 可保留;更稳妥的写法:"出巢时间大致在 4 月(美国的记录如此,原产地大体相近)"。

issues.claim: 恰在苹果开花之前——这是它被用来给苹果园授粉的主要原因之一;美国的飞行记录从 3 月到 6 月都有,以 4 月最多;越冬的成蜂破茧而出;雄蜂先出在巢口附近徘徊;随即交配
issues.problem: 已核对,全部被支持(记录用)。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons:"just prior to the blooming of apple orchards";Exotic Bee ID:"recorded in flight in the U.S from March to June, with the majority of occurrences through April.";"commonly used commercially for the pollination of apple orchards";Mason bee:"The adult matures either in the fall or winter, hibernating inside its insulatory cocoon.";"the males exit first"(并在巢附近等待雌蜂);"When the females emerge, they mate with one or several males."

issues.problem: 低severity·来源未直接给出产卵月份;但由 4 月出巢、交配后随即筑巢供粮,以及美国 3–6 月的飞行记录推断,5 月产卵为合理定位,不构成矛盾。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons:"Males emerge from their nests around April";Exotic Bee ID:"recorded in flight in the U.S from March to June, with the majority of occurrences through April."
issues.fix: 可改为"4–5 月"或"5 月前后"以体现时间弹性。

issues.claim: 卵产在花粉团上;孵化后幼虫趴在这团食物上开吃;独居蜂幼虫没有哺育蜂照料;雌蜂留下的一团花粉和花蜜是它从孵化到结茧的全部食物
issues.problem: 已核对,被支持。"花蜜"成分在本次抓取摘录的原句中仅以"provision mass"出现(Osmia cornifrons 词条称"pollen ball"),属壁蜂供粮的通用科普解释,不影响裁决。
issues.evidence: Osmia cornifrons:"Eggs are placed on top of the pollen ball.";Mason bee:"Once a provision mass is complete, the bee backs into the hole and lays an egg on top of the mass.";"Within weeks of hatching, the larva has probably consumed all of its provisions and begins spinning a cocoon around itself.";"Osmia species are solitary; every female is fertile and makes her own nest, and no worker bees for these species exist."
issues.fix: 无需修改;若求措辞与来源一致,可写"这一团以花粉为主、混有花蜜的蜂粮"。
